title: spp-physica-a run configuration
description: Generated from spp_unified/registry.py by `spp-physica-a describe --schema`. Cross-parameter constraints are checked by `validate`, not by this schema.

kind.description: Model to run: 'single' species or 'two' species.

state_every.description: Record positions and headings every state_every updates (plus the last). Descriptors use the last 10 recorded frames, so this changes the descriptor. Unit: updates.

rho.description: Packing density relative to hexagonal close packing. The particle count is n = max(8, round(rho * round(sqrt(3)/6 * (S/r0)^2))), so rho sets n, not a number per unit area. Higher rho gives more particles and quadratically longer runs. Very high rho can make initial non-overlapping placement fail. The single-species learned corpus used rho up to 0.70 at S=3.2. Unit: dimensionless.

v0.description: Self-propulsion speed. Each update moves a particle v0*dt along its new heading. Unit: simulation length unit per simulation time unit.

inertia.description: Weight of the current heading in the drive (heading persistence). Unit: dimensionless.

interaction_range_ratio.description: Pair-force cutoff r1 in units of r0. The force is repulsive just outside the hard core (2*r0), crosses zero, and is attractive up to r1. Also the radius used for the clustering and segregation measures. Unit: multiples of r0.

force_strength.description: Weight of the summed radial pair force in the drive. 0 disables pair forces in the heading update (overlap projection still applies). Unit: dimensionless.

adhesion.description: Attraction parameter B; beta = exp(tan(pi*B/2)) sets the attractive part of the force law. Larger B means stronger attraction. The code clips B to [-0.95, 0.95] (and tan to [-8, 8]) before mapping, so values beyond that have no further effect. Unit: dimensionless.

alignment_range_ratio.description: Alignment radius ra in units of r0: neighbors within ra contribute to the normalized alignment direction. Unit: multiples of r0.

alignment_strength.description: Weight of the local alignment direction in the drive. Larger values favor polar order (flocking). Unit: dimensionless.

gradient_angle.description: Direction of the constant taxis cue G. Fixed in the paper's searches (taxis strength 0). Unit: radian.

gradient_strength.description: Weight of the taxis cue in the drive. The paper uses gamma = 0. Unit: dimensionless.

noise.description: Angular noise amplitude: each update adds noise * U[-pi, pi] to the heading. Increasing noise destroys polar order (order-disorder transition). Unit: fraction of pi (angular noise amplitude).

fraction_B.description: Fraction of particles assigned to species B (n_B = round(fraction_B * n)). Labels are shuffled with seed+7919. Unit: dimensionless.

alignment_symmetric.description: Symmetric part of the cross-species alignment weight. 1 with J_a=0 makes species indistinguishable in alignment. Unit: dimensionless.

alignment_antisymmetric.description: Antisymmetric (non-reciprocal) part of the cross-species alignment weight: A aligns to B with Js+Ja, B to A with Js-Ja. Unit: dimensionless.

force_symmetric.description: Symmetric part of the additive cross-species radial coupling (linear envelope from 2*r0 to r1). Positive attracts. Unit: dimensionless.

force_antisymmetric.description: Antisymmetric (non-reciprocal) part of the additive cross-species radial coupling. Unit: dimensionless.

S.description: Side length of the square box. With r0 fixed, larger S means more particles at the same rho (cost grows as n^2). The paper uses S=4 (single-species learned corpus: S=3.2). Unit: simulation length unit.

r0.description: Particle radius; hard-core diameter is 2*r0. Interaction radii are multiples of r0. Unit: simulation length unit.

steps.description: Number of synchronous updates. Runtime is linear in steps. Unit: updates.

sample_start.description: Zero-based loop index at which order-parameter sampling begins (burn-in). Summary values average only over samples at or after it. Unit: updates.

sample_every.description: Sampling interval for the order-parameter time series. Unit: updates.

boundary.description: Box boundary: periodic (minimum image) or reflecting walls (normal heading component reversed).

dt.description: Time step. The paper uses dt=1. Changes displacement per update (v0*dt), not the number of updates. Unit: simulation time unit (one update has duration dt).

hard_core_strength.description: Finite replacement for the infinite hard-core repulsion: f(r) = -hard_core_strength for r <= 2*r0. Unit: dimensionless.

overlap_iterations.description: Overlap-projection passes after each update. Changing it changes the numerical trajectory; 3 does not guarantee zero overlaps in crowded states (see diagnostics). Unit: passes.

seed.description: Seed for numpy.random.default_rng; controls initial positions, headings, noise, and (two species, via seed+7919) species labels. All randomness flows from it. If omitted, `run` picks one, records it, and reports it on stderr. (The legacy `simulate` command and SimulationConfig default to 0.)

use_cell_list.description: Use the linked-cell neighbor accelerator (spp_unified/neighbors.py) instead of dense all-pairs. Its docstring states it finds exactly the same within-cutoff pairs; it falls back to the dense path for small n.

sweep.description: Only for `sweep`: dotted parameter name -> list of values (Cartesian product).

sample_start_before_steps.description: Sampling must start before the run ends.

box_exceeds_diameter.description: The box must be larger than one particle diameter.

particle_placement.expression: n particles fit on the initial grid with spacing >= 2.02*r0
particle_placement.description: Initial placement (geometry.initialize_positions) raises if rho is too high for the box.

r1_within_half_box.description: Clustering's periodic normalization and clean minimum-image geometry assume r1 <= S/2 (docs/NUMERICS.md). Runs still execute.

adhesion_clip.description: beta_from_adhesion clips B to [-0.95, 0.95]; larger magnitudes are silently equivalent to +/-0.95.

mixture_requires_two.description: The single model ignores mixture parameters; giving them is treated as a mistake.
